# synology_packages (Data Source)

Complete read-only installed-package inventory with exact versions, status, placement and update/lifecycle capability flags. It never refreshes the online catalogue, downloads SPKs, performs feasibility checks, resolves operation queues or starts/stops software. Failed and incomplete reads remain errors rather than empty inventories.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "synology_packages" "nas" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Inventory identity: packages.
- `packages` (Attributes Map) Installed packages keyed by stable DSM package ID. Use these keys for import. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))

<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Read-Only:

- `apps` (String) Observed package apps metadata.
- `automatic_updates` (Boolean) Observed package automatic_updates flag.
- `beta` (Boolean) Observed package beta flag.
- `can_uninstall` (Boolean) Observed package can_uninstall flag.
- `custom_uninstall` (Boolean) Observed package custom_uninstall flag.
- `id` (String) Observed package id metadata.
- `important_updates` (Boolean) Observed package important_updates flag.
- `name` (String) Observed package name metadata.
- `silent_upgrade` (Boolean) Observed package silent_upgrade flag.
- `startable` (Boolean) Observed package startable flag.
- `status` (String) Observed package status metadata.
- `version` (String) Observed package version metadata.
- `volume` (String) Observed package volume metadata.
